notes: Admins can now publish Premium Templates directly from inside the app (Settings → Publish as Premium Template) — no more exporting a file and hand-committing it to GitHub. The catalog moved to Supabase (Storage + a database table), gated by an admin flag only the project owner can grant. Also added an editable custom watermark text (previously fixed to "Made with Screens"), and a scan/build erase-quality fix for text boxes that sit close to a differently colored edge (a card, an icon).
